events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up with product discovery, samples, self-guided meditation and limited scheduled guided meditation sessions.
events.what_is_free: Public pop-up access, product discovery, samples and self-guided meditation; special guided sessions have limited reserved capacity.
events.caveats: Special guided meditation sessions require/respect limited reservations. Self-guided meditation spots are available by reservation or first-come, first-served. Do not imply that a general RSVP guarantees a special session.
events.practical_notes: Vanderbilt Hall at Grand Central. Monday Sept. 21 runs 9 AM–7 PM; Tuesday Sept. 22 runs 8 AM–7 PM.

events.event_name: Graeter's × The Paper Ice Cream Truck
events.address: Washington St between Little W 12th & Gansevoort St; then Castle Clinton Plaza across from 17 State St, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A two-stop Manhattan ice-cream-truck activation celebrating season 2 of Peacock's The Paper with Graeter's limited-edition flavors.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary samples of the limited-edition Graeter's ice cream bundle while available.
events.caveats: Samples are promotional and may be limited by supply. The truck changes location midday; use the correct time/location window.
events.practical_notes: 12–2 PM in Meatpacking on Washington St between Little W 12th & Gansevoort; 3:30–7 PM at The Battery across from 17 State St in Castle Clinton Plaza.

events.address: The Hub, 115 Bowery, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: Welcome to Chinatown's Test Thursday featuring Kem, a Vietnamese coffee counter concept with coffee, matcha and pandan waffles.
events.what_is_free: Samples of classic Vietnamese coffee are advertised for visitors to try.
events.caveats: The host explicitly says the event is open to all and no RSVP is required. Products are also available to shop.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–6 PM at Welcome to Chinatown's The Hub, 115 Bowery.

events.address: Bogardus Plaza, 5 Hudson St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A one-day OXO Climate Week Tiny Kitchen with chef-curated bites, coffee, sustainability programming and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee and chef-curated bites; Swivel Peelers while supplies last. RSVP enters guests for a chance at one of the first 50 Rapid Brewers.
events.caveats: The event is described as open to the public. RSVP is tied to the Rapid Brewer giveaway opportunity rather than established as an admission requirement; giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–4 PM at Bogardus Plaza.

events.what_it_is: A limited-time Native × Peanuts street cart celebrating the collaboration with product sampling and surprise giveaway moments.
events.what_is_free: Sample giveaways are advertised, including a get-one/give-one concept, plus surprise giveaway moments on site.
events.caveats: Open to the public according to current event listings. Promotional samples/giveaways can run out; no advance admission requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 25, 9 AM–4 PM, on Broadway between Prince and Houston at 600 Broadway.

events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive Discover South Carolina activation with travel experiences, mini golf, photo moments, Palmetto State culture and swag opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free; interactive experiences and potential swag/giveaways are included while supplies last.
events.caveats: Official Grand Central guidance says admission is first-come, first-served. Registration is available, but current corroborating event guidance says a ticket does not guarantee entry. Food and giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 25–26: 9 AM–7 PM. Sept. 27: 9 AM–2 PM. Vanderbilt Hall at Grand Central Terminal.
